subject: HISTORY
description: ICSE 10th History: First World War, Rise of Fascism & Nazism, Second World War, United Nations & Major Agencies

questions.question: The assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand at Sarajevo sparked which global conflict?
questions.explanation: The assassination of Austro-Hungarian heir Archduke Franz Ferdinand in June 1914 triggered WWI.

questions.question: Which treaty concluded World War I in 1919 with harsh terms on Germany?
questions.explanation: The Treaty of Versailles signed in 1919 held Germany responsible for the war losses.

questions.question: How many permanent members are there in the United Nations Security Council (UNSC)?
questions.explanation: The 5 permanent members with veto power are USA, UK, France, Russia, and China.

questions.question: Which United Nations agency is tasked with preserving cultural, educational, and natural heritage?
questions.explanation: UNESCO (UN Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization) designates World Heritage Sites.

questions.question: Where is the principal seat of the International Court of Justice (ICJ) located?
questions.explanation: The Peace Palace in The Hague, Netherlands is the headquarters of the ICJ.
